plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026) — T18 Watch complete, steps 2-3
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9, fast-xml-parser
domain: openvibe.watch (vhost in deploy/nginx: an internal-service page, health and JSON 404s; the API is loopback-only; README "Public host")
deployment: Not deployed. Plan T18 steps 2-3 are implemented and tested in the repository (registry, check engine, http/feed/api carriers, conditional GET, extraction, conditions, observations, check runs, the API, the events); nothing runs on the host yet, and openvibe.watch has no DNS or vhost installed.
features: watch registry with owner scoping (404 for another owner) validated against the released contracts
binding carrier preference order: webhook/event → ETag/Last-Modified → feed → API → Run
conditional GET: If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since, HEAD-first when only change is needed, 304 and unchanged-body short circuits
SSRF-guarded fetcher (ports, private hosts, every redirect hop, byte cap, one deadline) and per-host spacing
extraction: text, html, css subset, json/jsonpath, regex; ai refused as a later step
conditions: changed/threshold with tolerance and percent, for_sec debounce over the observation trail
observations with value hashes, capped snapshots and retention
check runs with the full terminal-state set, exponential backoff and Retry-After
POST /api/v1/watches/:id/check plus the observations and checks reads
watch.* events through the outbox in the same transaction as the state change
